description: Gate and verify autonomous AI agent action decisions (e.g. trades, emails, claims, API calls, wallet transfers) via EthersFlow Multi-Model Federated Adversarial Consensus before execution.

agent_action.description: The proposed action or decision the autonomous agent intends to take.

agent_count.description: Number of adversarial audit nodes (2 to 7, default 3).

context.description: Optional structured context or evidence payload.

persona_preset.description: Audit persona preset for specialized domain compliance.

policy_id.description: Optional policy pack identifier to evaluate against.

reasoning_chain.description: Optional internal reasoning chain or context supporting the decision.

scope_hint.description: Optional domain or task scope hint (e.g. 'clinical_safety', 'financial_compliance', 'legal_citation', 'cybersecurity_auditor').

name: verify_agent_action
